evidence: Finds a child by ID, calls UI_ClearPendingClipFlag on it and sets window +0xe0 to force a redraw.
Appends a unique (command,value) pair to the window array at +0x2a8; callers register mappings such as (0x431,0xd).
Looks up a child by ID and forwards (id,text) to UI_SetLabelIdText on that child.
Allocates a 0x7c render record, resolves its sprite/record ids from the map table by type/state and links it into the object list at +0xc4.
Reads the object's two map floats and calls Map_ComputeBlitRect with map screen offsets +0xf8/+0xfc or the +0xa0/+0xd0 origin.
Clears the UI pending-sprite helper at +0x8310 via UI_ClearChildExtent and releases the optional object at +0x8314 through its vtable.
Buckets record +0xc values by city group, averages each bucket, then returns round(mean of groups 1..5)*100 clamped to 0..100.
Resets project fields to -1/0 and clears the +0x68 node list; called by the constructor and after a build project completes.
Scans player subrecords at +0x180 for one whose lookup table contains the city id stored at +0x3c.
Calls Rating_GetComposite and returns its truncated integer, with a switch on person type +0x824 that has no remaining cases.
Looks up the message queue at +0x304 by event type +0x34; callers use it before creating a matching message.
For four periods sums Stats_SumFilteredFloats minus Stats_SumFilteredFloats2 over all player subrecords.
Returns the object's map position plus the +0xa0/+0xd0 screen origin through two output pointers.
Selects buffer 1 through Object_GetBufferPair and returns the record count stored in that buffer's second field.
Composes primary and mask sprites with hotspots, allocates an intermediate sprite, blits scaled 16-bit rows and unions the dirty rect.
For a record at +0x18/+0x1c, checks the target cell and two neighbors in its facing direction for records with +0xc > 0.
Counts map records matching mission categories 0x16/0x17/0x1b, excluding +0x108==6 and subtypes 0x19/0x1a.
Allocates a 0x24 map-object record from a tile type and coordinates, resolves city and building price, then appends it to the object list.
Counts objects within a 300-unit radius by +4 type, flags type 0x20 and counts entries whose +0x48 field is not -1.
Looks up the selected object's sprite, aligns it with UI_AlignSpriteToRect and blits the resulting rectangle.
Scans all player input objects for a Game_MapInputIndex value greater than the argument, returning 0/1.
Counts records of type 0x1d (excluding subtypes 0xe/0x19/0x1a) plus all type 0x1e records.
When active, updates the 3D position and counts down or refreshes the +0x144 re-trigger timer.
Iterates the map field range and returns the largest Stats_SumValuesByCategory result.
Sums Game_CountObjectsByType over every subrecord in the player's +0x148 map.
Stores a 0..2 preset at +0x2da0, calls Sound_ApplyVolumePreset and mirrors it to +0x384 when +0x33c is clear.
Renders one clipped 8-bit glyph bitmap into a surface with palette/color remap; the caller supplies glyph width, height and offsets.
Selects a 0..2 action from state +0x44 and player building counts, stores a table value at +0x4c and adjusts +0x84 for types 2/3.
Moves an object record to a new map cell, releases old cell references, links the new cell/neighbor and updates occupancy counters.
Grows the object's +0x9c buffer by one 0x28 record, fills position/type fields and returns the new record.
Scans player object status flags and plays one of speech ids 8/0x1b-0x20 as a city advisory.
Updates the indexed 0x28 record in the object's +0x9c/+0xa4 buffer with new position, sprite cell and type fields.
Finds the nearest map record of type 0x1a/0x1b/0x1c to the message position using Manhattan distance.
Advances the +0x8c fade state using timeGetTime, clamps +0x9c and applies the value through Sound_SetBufferVolume.
Finds the nearest record by Map_FindShortestPath and derives an 8-way angle from its +0xc/+0x10 position.
Averages each player's building ratings and returns band 3/2/1 when the maximum exceeds 0x50/0x3b/0x28, else 0.
Recolors the pending sprite via 0x53d840 and Sprite_FillColor8, then unions the old and new extents as dirty rectangles.
Averages Rating_ClampAdjusted plus Rating_AdjustA over all player objects, divided by the object count.
Sums Stats_SumFilteredFloats3 over all six players and returns band 3/2/1 above 0x3c/0x31/0x27.
Offsets the object's rect by its +0x24/+0x28 origin under the game lock and blits it with Gfx_BlitRectList.
Returns 2 for free 0x1a/1b/1c buildings, 3 for low rating, 1 for shortage records and 0 otherwise.
Scans the 10-entry list at +param1*0x168+0x74 for a matching type/value and removes it with UI_RemoveListEntryAt.
Sums Stats_SumFilteredFloats over a supplied record, or across every player subrecord when the +0x15c map is used.
Dispatches on DAT_0057d62c to sum stat grids, record float matrices or player matrices, returning -3 for modes 3-5.
Writes the four speech/volume settings to globals, loads the speech set and converts/applies volumes at +0x1d4/+0x1d8.
Returns Matrix_MaxByRow9x8 for a supplied object or scans the 8x9 stat grid for the maximum.
Counts map records whose +0xa0 field is nonzero; the sound code scales ambient volume by this count over 40.
If +0x14c4 exists and the context type is 0x11/0x13/0x14, returns the composite rating; otherwise returns param_2 shifted into the high dword.
Iterates an ID map, releases each object through vtable slot 0 and then resets the list.
Counts active objects of types 0x1d/0x1e/0x1f and returns bands 3/2/1/0 at thresholds 20/11/5.
Clears the list and collects objects by owner for all six player slots.
Resolves the current player and calls UI_GetRecordCenteredRect with this+0x24 through the player's +0xfa8 UI.
Finds a record by its +0x164 id and removes it from the +0x19c4 tracked-object list.
Plays s_Sfx_Sfx_City_Police_wav when the sound object is active.
Convenience wrapper around Surface_Lock(surface,0).
Validates volume under two critical sections, sets the buffer volume through SoundBuffer_SetVolume and signals the +0x48 event.
Validates the requested volume against the buffer range or 100..100000, then calls SoundBuffer_SetVolume.
Rebuilds the current music object from the current player's first record when the owning company changes and calls Sound_SelectCurrentTrack.
Gets the object's ID and removes the matching window from the UI manager with UI_RemoveWindowByID.
